build_densenet_cifar: build a DenseNet model for CIFAR-10 classification with growth rate 12 and bottleneck blocks
build_densenet121: build a DenseNet-121 model with 4 dense blocks containing 6, 12, 24, 16 bottleneck layers
build_densenet169: build a DenseNet-169 model with 4 dense blocks containing 6, 12, 32, 32 bottleneck layers
build_densenet201: build a DenseNet-201 model with 4 dense blocks containing 6, 12, 48, 32 bottleneck layers
build_densenet161: build a DenseNet-161 model with growth rate 48 and 4 dense blocks of 6, 12, 36, 24 layers
